title: M4Bench: Evaluating Procedural Specification for Clinical EHR Derivation Agents
title_zh: M4Bench：评估临床电子病历派生智能体的过程规范

paragraphs.en: Clinical research over electronic health records depends on derived variables whose definitions sit outside the schema, in item codes, time windows, missingness rules, and output-grain choices that change cohorts and downstream conclusions. We introduce M4Bench, 28 clinical derivation tasks across 15 task families on MIMIC-IV and eICU, to test whether AI coding agents can reproduce such derivations and how clinician-reviewed agent skills change their results. Its controls decompose the value of skills into specification completeness, delivery format, and schema familiarity. In a Docker-isolated Codex campaign (GPT 5.4 Mini and GPT 5.5), skills raise reward, the mean match rate over scored output columns, by 0.136 over the no-skill baseline, with 26 of 28 tasks improving. Specification completeness accounts for most of this gain: on an eight-task control subset, an operational spec alone raises reward by 0.162, and skills add only 0.024 on top, a difference indistinguishable from zero. On a ten-task subset, decoy skills score like no skill and raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills, arguing against generic context or the skill format as the explanation. Schema obfuscation and restructuring preserve 86% and 70% of the skill gain (GPT 5.4 Mini, 26 MIMIC-IV tasks), a descriptive robustness check rather than a bound on memorization. A descriptive Claude Code replication on all 28 tasks (Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6, 560 runs) is directionally consistent (+0.120, 21 of 28 tasks improving). These gains are partial agreement with the reference, not completed tasks: only 25 of 280 with-skill and 13 of 280 no-skill Codex runs pass every strict check, and skills barely change which rows agents return (key F1 +0.003). Skills are released as a versioned, clinician-reviewable markdown delivery format, with a family-level reference-validity audit. M4Bench releases tasks, skills, evaluation code, and sanitized per-run evidence as an open-source benchmark .

paragraphs.en: Observational clinical research using electronic health records (EHRs) commonly relies on derived variables: severity scores such as Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) ( Vincent et al., 1996 ) and Acute Physiology Score III (APS-III) ( Knaus et al., 1991 ) , organ-dysfunction measures such as Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) acute kidney injury staging ( KDIGO Acute Kidney Injury Work Group, 2012 ) and Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) ( Kamath et al., 2001 ) , and cohort-defining phenotypes such as suspected infection and Sepsis-3 ( Singer et al., 2016 ) . These variables are rarely available as simple columns. They are reconstructed from raw tables whose clinical meaning is distributed across item identifiers, units, documentation practices, time windows, and dataset-specific conventions, and the implementation choices behind a single derivation change cohort membership, score distributions, and downstream conclusions in observational studies ( Johnson et al., 2017 ; Johnson et al., 2018 ; Ostropolets et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 使用电子健康记录（EHR）的观察性临床研究通常依赖于衍生变量：严重程度评分如序贯器官衰竭评估（SOFA）（Vincent et al., 1996）和急性生理学评分III（APS-III）（Knaus et al., 1991），器官功能障碍指标如肾脏病：改善全球预后（KDIGO）急性肾损伤分期（KDIGO Acute Kidney Injury Work Group, 2012）和终末期肝病模型（MELD）（Kamath et al., 2001），以及用于定义队列的表型如疑似感染和脓毒症-3（Singer et al., 2016）。 这些变量很少以简单的数据列形式提供。 它们是从原始数据表中重建出来的，其临床含义分布在条目标识符、单位、记录实践、时间窗口和数据集特有的约定之中，而在观察性研究中，单个衍生计算背后的实现选择会改变队列成员构成、评分分布以及下游结论（Johnson et al., 2017; Johnson et al., 2018; Ostropolets et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: Modern agents can inspect schemas, execute SQL, debug code, and iterate on tests, and recent work measures their ability to translate clinical questions into SQL or to interact with EHR data ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Yet clinical derivation tasks often require procedural knowledge that is invisible from schema structure alone. A SOFA implementation, for example, needs the score definition plus how vasopressors are encoded, how oxygenation variables are paired, how ventilation status changes respiratory scoring, and how missing components are handled in a specific database release. This procedural knowledge is held by clinicians and embedded in community concept code such as the MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code repository ( Johnson et al., 2018 ) , but no benchmark we are aware of represents it as an auditable agent artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 现代智能体可以检查模式、执行 SQL、调试代码并对测试进行迭代，近期的研究工作衡量了它们将临床问题转化为 SQL 或与电子健康记录（EHR）数据交互的能力（Lee et al., 2022; Shi et al., 2024; Jiang et al., 2025）。 然而临床衍生任务往往需要仅凭模式结构无法获知的程序性知识。 例如，一个 SOFA 的实现不仅需要该评分的定义，还需要了解血管活性药物如何编码、氧合变量如何配对、通气状态如何改变呼吸评分，以及在特定数据库版本中缺失组件如何处理。 这些程序性知识由临床医生掌握，并体现在社区概念代码（如 MIT-LCP 的 MIMIC-Code 代码库）中（Johnson et al., 2018），但据我们所知，尚无基准将其表示为可审计的智能体产物。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench studies this gap as an evaluation problem. Rather than asking whether an agent can answer clinical questions in free text, M4Bench asks whether a coding agent can reproduce declared EHR research derivations and whether explicit procedural specifications change that behavior. The benchmark is motivated by a broader goal: enabling clinicians and clinical researchers to convert tacit procedural knowledge about EHR derivations into versioned, auditable artifacts that agents can use during implementation. The central question is how human domain expertise should be represented and evaluated for supervised research workflows.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 将这一差距作为一个评估问题进行研究。 M4Bench 不是询问智能体能否以自由文本形式回答临床问题，而是询问编程智能体能否复现已声明的电子健康记录（EHR）研究推导过程，以及显式的程序规范是否会改变这种行为。 该基准测试源于一个更宏大的目标：让临床医生和临床研究人员能够将关于 EHR 推导的隐性程序性知识转化为带版本、可审计的工件，供智能体在实现过程中使用。 核心问题在于，在监督式研究工作流中，人类领域专业知识应当如何被表示和评估。

paragraphs.en: The primary specification format is an agent skill : a markdown procedural artifact, in the spirit of Agent Skills ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , that summarizes the clinical rules, item identifiers, time windows, and output grain for one task family. Skills are reusable procedural artifacts and contain no hidden reference outputs. Each task and associated artifact is reviewed by two clinicians. This review supports face validity, output-schema consistency, and clinical-definition provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的规范格式是智能体技能：一种 markdown 程序性产物，秉承 Agent Skills（Zhang et al., 2025a）的精神，为单个任务族总结临床规则、条目标识符、时间窗口和输出粒度。 技能是可复用的程序性产物，不包含任何隐藏的参考输出。 每个任务及其相关产物均由两名临床医生进行审阅。 该审阅支持表面效度、输出模式一致性以及临床定义的可溯源性。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark is designed around a controlled ablation (Figure 1 ). In the no-skill condition, an agent receives the task instruction and database access, but no curated derivation procedure. This condition represents schema-plus-task access, not a fully specified clinical protocol baseline. In the with-skill condition, the same agent also receives the task-specific procedural skill. The submitted CSV is evaluated column by column against hidden reference outputs. The estimand is the change in agreement with declared reference implementations when curated clinical implementation knowledge is supplied.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试围绕受控消融设计（图 1）。 在无技能条件下，智能体会获得任务指令和数据库访问权限，但不会获得经过整理的推导流程。 该条件代表的是“模式加任务”的访问，而非完整指定的临床协议基线。 在有技能条件下，同一智能体还会获得特定任务的过程性技能。 提交的 CSV 文件会针对隐藏的参考输出逐列进行评估。 该估计量是指当提供经过整理的临床实现知识时，与已声明参考实现的一致性的变化。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench estimates the native-schema with-skill – no-skill reward difference for the same task, database, model, and execution protocol, with tasks weighted equally after model-level averaging. The tested procedural context comes from public MIT-LCP concept code, eICU conventions, clinician review, and task adaptations. Scores measure agreement with declared public-code reference derivations, not clinical correctness: clinician review flagged, for example, that broad culture inclusion can overcall suspected infection, that SOFA defaults missing organ components to zero, and that the vasopressor mapping omits angiotensin II (Appendix Table 9 ). Clinician-adjudicated and multiple accepted targets are the priority for future versions. The evidence is MIMIC-IV-dominant: 26 of 28 tasks use MIMIC-IV, and the two eICU tasks are cross-database probes, not evidence of database or hospital generality. M4Bench does not identify a causal effect of clinician review, provider-general behavior, memorization-free reasoning, or a unique effect of the skill format.

paragraphs.en: A benchmark object: 28 clinical EHR derivation tasks across 15 task families over MIMIC-IV and eICU, with clinician-reviewed skills, OS-level isolation, contamination-lint, and sanitized per-run audit logs plus a family-level reference-validity audit so that benchmark targets and known caveats are inspectable.

paragraphs.en: M4Bench builds on credentialed critical-care databases, MIMIC-IV ( Johnson et al., 2023 ) and eICU ( Pollard et al., 2018 ) , on community reference implementations such as MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code ( Johnson et al., 2018 ) , and on the M3 agent infrastructure for clinical EHR access ( Attrach et al., 2025 ) . Prior clinical EHR benchmarks and agent methods cover few-shot prediction, text-to-SQL, structured-table question answering, cohort and feature extraction, or tool-using clinical agents ( Wornow et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Retrieval-augmented medical question answering is benchmarked separately by MIRAGE ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) . Unlike RWE-bench’s end-to-end observational-study protocols over MIMIC-IV ( Li et al., 2026a ) , M4Bench isolates reusable derivation components such as SOFA, suspected infection, ventilation, vasopressor-equivalent dose, and rolling urine output, then scores reproductions against declared references under a direct no-skill versus with-skill ablation.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 建立在经过认证的危重症数据库 MIMIC-IV（Johnson et al., 2023）和 eICU（Pollard et al., 2018）、社区参考实现（如 MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code（Johnson et al., 2018）），以及用于临床电子健康记录访问的 M3 智能体基础设施（Attrach et al., 2025）之上。 先前的临床电子健康记录基准和智能体方法涵盖少样本预测、文本到 SQL、结构化表格问答、队列与特征提取，或使用工具的临床智能体（Wornow et al., 2023；Lee et al., 2022；Shi et al., 2024；Lee et al., 2025；Yang et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2026；Jiang et al., 2025）。 检索增强的医学问答由 MIRAGE（Xiong et al., 2024）单独进行基准测试。 与 RWE-bench 在 MIMIC-IV 上的端到端观察性研究流程（Li et al., 2026a）不同，M4Bench 将可复用的派生组件（如 SOFA、疑似感染、机械通气、血管升压药等效剂量和滚动尿量）单独拆分出来，然后在直接的“无技能对有技能”消融设置下，依据声明的参考标准对复现结果进行评分。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench also differs from medical-calculator benchmarks, which test formula recall, extraction, or arithmetic from notes or synthetic patient descriptions ( Khandekar et al., 2024 ; Krohn-Grimberghe, 2026 ) . Real EHR derivations also depend on item identifiers, time windows, unit conversion, missingness conventions, and output grain. Harmonization efforts such as CLIF and OHDSI/OMOP standardize clinical data and definitions across settings ( Rojas et al., 2025 ; Hripcsak et al., 2015 ) . M4Bench instead asks whether coding agents can reproduce a fixed set of declared derivations under controlled conditions.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 也不同于医学计算器基准，后者测试从病历或合成患者描述中回忆公式、提取数据或进行算术运算（ Khandekar et al., 2024 ; Krohn-Grimberghe, 2026 ）。 真实的电子健康记录派生计算还依赖于条目标识符、时间窗口、单位转换、缺失值约定以及输出粒度。 CLIF 和 OHDSI/OMOP 等协调工作在不同场景中标准化了临床数据和定义（ Rojas et al., 2025 ; Hripcsak et al., 2015 ）。 M4Bench 则考察智能体能否在受控条件下复现一组固定的、已声明的派生计算。

paragraphs.en: Agent skills are reusable file-based procedural-knowledge artifacts that agents can discover and load at run time ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . SkillsBench studies such artifacts across domains, but only a few of its tasks involve clinical data, too few to establish whether skill effects are broad or reliable across EHR derivations ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Structured-prompting and prompt-sensitivity work likewise show that procedural context can change model behavior ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Zhuo et al., 2024 ) . M4Bench measures the effect of supplying task-specific procedural knowledge in a released, auditable form, without claiming a unique benefit for one packaging format.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能是可复用的、基于文件的过程性知识产物，智能体可以在运行时发现并加载它们（Zhang et al., 2025a）。 SkillsBench 研究了跨领域的这类产物，但其中只有少数任务涉及临床数据，数量太少，无法确定技能效应在 EHR 推导中是否具有广泛性或可靠性（Li et al., 2026b）。 结构化提示与提示敏感性方面的研究同样表明，过程性上下文可以改变模型行为（Khattab et al., 2024；Zhuo et al., 2024）。 M4Bench 以已发布、可审计的形式衡量提供任务特定过程性知识的效果，而不声称某一种打包格式具有独特优势。

paragraphs.en: Finally, M4Bench inherits concerns from coding-agent benchmarks such as SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) : isolation, reproducibility, and contamination matter when agents can inspect code and files. Contamination is a known threat to such benchmarks and has motivated continuously updated or contamination-resistant evaluations ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . M4Bench therefore reports OS-level isolation, artifact retention, and contamination checks, and treats schema perturbations as probes of schema familiarity only.

paragraphs.en: Each task gives the agent a clinical derivation target and a task database. The agent must write output.csv with required identifier columns and value columns. Evaluation checks that the output is valid CSV, contains required columns, covers the expected key set, and matches reference value columns within task-specific tolerances. paragraphs.en: Each task-specific skill is a markdown procedural artifact in the spirit of Agent Skills ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Skills are derived from public clinical definitions, MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code, and eICU concept-code conventions ( Johnson et al., 2018 ; Pollard et al., 2018 ) , then adapted into implementation guidance for one declared reference convention, not universal clinical knowledge. Each task-specific skill and paired task specification was independently reviewed by two clinicians. Disagreements and requests for clarification were resolved through consensus discussion, and reviewer identifiers C1–C4 are reported in the provenance appendix. The four reviewing clinicians are co-authors of this paper, so the review is internal to the author team and is not external validation. This review checks definition provenance, task framing, and artifact plausibility. Skills may include formulas, item identifiers, table families, time-window rules, missingness conventions, unit conversions, output-grain reminders, and edge-case cautions. The primary skills contain no executable SQL snippets, hidden reference-output paths, row-level answers, exact result tables, or full solution programs. Raw SQL appears only in a matched-content control.

paragraphs.en: The MIT-LCP and eICU conventions used for these reference outputs are widely adopted research implementations, not clinically validated gold standards. Clinician review identified cases where public concept code diverges from source clinical definitions or omits clinically relevant edge cases. Appendix Table 9 summarizes the highest-impact reference-validity caveats. We retain the public reference implementations for the current evidence package because changing them would redefine the benchmark target and require rerunning affected tasks. Future versions should add clinician-adjudicated reference targets alongside public-code targets, so that M4Bench can separately measure agreement with community convention and agreement with clinical intent.

paragraphs.en: After submission we ran Claude Code with requested Opus ( claude-opus-4-7 ) and Sonnet ( claude-sonnet-4-6 ) on all 28 native tasks, no-skill and with-skill , five trials per cell, under the frozen task, skill, and evaluator definitions and the same Docker path: 560 canonical runs from three results roots on two machines, selected by a declared manifest, with 656 failed, quarantined, superseded, or overlapping attempts inventoried and excluded (Appendix F ). The harness was not uniform: Claude Code 2.1.119 and 2.1.220 both occur, partly by condition (167/280 no-skill versus 100/280 with-skill runs on 2.1.119). Model-slot overrides are recorded for 230 runs and the rest use native routing, whose traces report ancillary claude-haiku-4-5 usage in 330 runs and Haiku assistant turns in 5. We therefore treat the 28-task contrast as descriptive and add a sensitivity analysis on tasks whose no-skill and with-skill cells share one recorded CLI version and routing profile per model. This matches recorded indicators, not every ancillary model call.
paragraphs.zh: 提交后，我们在全部 28 个原生任务上以申请到的 Opus（claude-opus-4-7）和 Sonnet（claude-sonnet-4-6）运行 Claude Code，包括无技能与有技能两种条件，每个单元格五次试验，并在冻结的任务、技能与评估器定义以及相同的 Docker 路径下进行：来自两台机器上三个结果根目录的 560 次规范运行，依据一份公开声明的清单进行选取，同时清点并排除了 656 次失败、被隔离、被取代或重叠的尝试（附录 F）。 测试框架并不统一：Claude Code 2.1.119 与 2.1.220 两个版本都出现了，部分取决于实验条件（2.1.119 上无技能为 167/280，有技能为 100/280）。 有 230 次运行记录了模型槽位的覆盖，其余运行使用原生路由，其轨迹显示有 330 次运行涉及辅助性的 claude-haiku-4-5 使用，另有 5 次运行出现 Haiku 的智能体回合。 因此，我们将这 28 个任务的对比视为描述性的，并针对无技能与有技能单元格共享同一记录 CLI 版本及每模型路由配置的任务，补充了一项敏感性分析。 这与记录的指标相符，但并非涵盖每一次辅助性的模型调用。

paragraphs.en: Paper campaigns enforce benchmark-internal isolation at the OS/container layer and fail closed if an agent can read hidden reference outputs, task internals, previous results, or evaluator internals. Post-run auditing excludes or fails traces that mention answer paths, evaluator internals, exact answer-copying behavior, or byte-identical outputs against decompressed answer files. The final Codex campaign passed publishability, isolation, filesystem-canary, and contamination-lint checks for all 760 canonical runs, as did all 560 canonical Claude replication runs, whose egress logs show no disallowed hosts or denied requests. Full audit counts appear in Appendices E and F .
paragraphs.zh: 论文竞赛在操作系统/容器层强制实施基准内部的隔离，并采取“默认失败”策略：一旦智能体能够读取隐藏的参考答案、任务内部信息、先前结果或评估器内部信息，即判定失败。 赛后审计会排除或判定失败那些提及答案路径、评估器内部信息、精确复制答案行为，或与解压后的答案文件逐字节相同的输出的轨迹。 最终的 Codex 竞赛在全部 760 次规范运行中通过了可发布性、隔离性、文件系统金丝雀和污染检查测试；全部 560 次规范 Claude 复现运行也同样通过，其出站日志显示没有任何被禁止的主机或被拒绝的请求。 完整的审计计数见附录 E 和附录 F。

paragraphs.en: Schema perturbations run agents on obfuscated or restructured schemas while preserving underlying data values. They are schema-familiarity probes, not full data-value decontamination tests. Matched-context controls use decoy skills and raw reference SQL to test whether gains are caused merely by longer context, by direct reference-code exposure, or by task-specific procedural guidance. For raw tasks, raw reference SQL can reference intermediate tables removed from the task database, so these cells are SQL-adaptation controls, not executable answer-copying controls. The May 6 validity follow-up adds two non-primary controls: an operational-spec condition on an eight-task control subset for both Codex models, and transformed-schema with-skill cells for GPT 5.4 Mini over the 26 MIMIC tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Schema 扰动是在混淆或重构后的 schema 上运行智能体，同时保留底层数据值。 它们是 schema 熟悉度探针，而非完整的数据值去污染测试。 匹配上下文对照使用诱饵技能和原始参考 SQL，以检验收益究竟是仅仅来自更长的上下文、来自直接接触参考代码，还是来自针对特定任务的过程性指导。 对于原始任务，原始参考 SQL 可能引用已从任务数据库中移除的中间表，因此这些单元是 SQL 适配对照，而非可执行的答案复制对照。 5 月 6 日的有效性后续工作增加了两个非主要对照：在八任务对照子集上针对两个 Codex 模型的操作规范条件，以及针对 26 个 MIMIC 任务的 GPT 5.4 Mini 带技能的转换 schema 单元。

paragraphs.en: On the ten-task decoy/raw-SQL subset, decoy skills match no-skill (0.554 vs 0.553), arguing against generic extra context as the explanation. Raw reference SQL nearly matches targeted skills (0.837 vs 0.833, Δ = \Delta= 0.003), so reference-implementation structure already carries most of the signal once it is present (Appendix Table 22 ). Operational specifications (complete non-SQL derivation rules without item identifiers or dataset recipes) improve over no-skill by +0.162 [0.072, 0.260] on the eight-task subset, while clinician-reviewed targeted skills add only +0.024 [-0.034, 0.099] on top (Table 4 ). The combined targeted-skill effect on all 28 native tasks is +0.136 [0.085, 0.191] (Table 3 ), family-cluster sensitivity [0.065, 0.207], family-balanced bootstrap +0.120 [0.057, 0.190] (Appendix Table 19 ), sign-flip p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} , with 26/28 tasks improving and ordered-value nMAE falling from 0.116 to 0.060. Skills are therefore one clinician-reviewable delivery format for explicit procedural specification. The control subsets were purposive: both task lists were fixed in the benchmark matrix before their first runs, and they over-represent large-effect tasks (the targeted-skill delta is +0.280 on the 10 decoy/raw-SQL tasks versus +0.056 on the other 18, and +0.186 on the eight operational-spec tasks versus +0.116), and the operational-spec subset has no eICU task. Mechanism conclusions apply to these subsets (Appendix Table 13 ).

paragraphs.en: The continuous reward measures partial agreement on matched keys, not end-to-end correctness. paragraphs.en: The largest gains occur on tasks requiring implementation-level knowledge: rolling urine-output windows, MELD edge cases, suspected-infection timing, baseline-creatinine hierarchy, and ventilation status. Grain errors concentrate in raw Sepsis-3, raw ventilation, and raw suspected infection (key F1 0.68 to 0.87). Per-task deltas and mode splits appear in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Schema obfuscation and restructuring alter the database interface while preserving underlying values. In a GPT 5.4 Mini follow-up over the 26 MIMIC tasks, transformed-schema with-skill cells remain positive when matched to the transformed-schema no-skill cells from the earlier probe: +0.135 [0.068, 0.208] on obfuscated schemas and +0.110 [0.057, 0.170] on restructured schemas, or 0.862 and 0.704 of the native-schema gain (Appendix Table 23 ). We read these ratios descriptively. Treating the shortfall as the share of the effect due to schema-name memorization would require that the perturbations change nothing else about task difficulty and that the April no-skill probe and May with-skill runs are exchangeable. Neither is established, and the transformed-schema no-skill runs are not in the retained evidence packages (Appendix D ). The probe says nothing about value-level memorization or provider, hospital, or database generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 模式混淆与模式重构会在保留底层数值的前提下改变数据库接口。 在一项针对 26 个 MIMIC 任务的 GPT 5.4 Mini 后续实验中，当与先前探针中的变换模式无技能组匹配时，变换模式有技能组的结果仍为正：在混淆模式上为 +0.135 [0.068, 0.208]，在重构模式上为 +0.110 [0.057, 0.170]，即原生模式增益的 0.862 和 0.704（附录表 23）。 我们对这些比率仅作描述性解读。 若把这一差距视为归因于模式名称记忆的效应份额，则需要假设这些扰动不会以其他任何方式改变任务难度，并且 4 月的无技能探针与 5 月的有技能实验可以互换。 这两点均未得到证实，且变换模式的无技能实验不在保留的证据包中（附录 D）。 该探针并未涉及数值层面的记忆，也未涉及跨提供商、跨医院或跨数据库的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench measures whether agents can implement declared clinical EHR reference derivations and whether explicit procedural specifications close implementation gaps. The tasks cover critical-care severity scores, organ dysfunction, comorbidity, infection, respiratory support, medications, and rolling windows over MIMIC-IV and eICU. The benchmark does not measure bedside reasoning, diagnosis, treatment planning, real-time prediction, or downstream study validity.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 衡量智能体能否实现已声明的临床 EHR 参考推导，以及明确的程序性规范能否弥合实现差距。 任务涵盖重症监护严重程度评分、器官功能障碍、合并症、感染、呼吸支持、用药，以及基于 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 的滚动窗口。 该基准不衡量床旁推理、诊断、治疗规划、实时预测或下游研究的有效性。

sents.zh: 任务涵盖重症监护严重程度评分、器官功能障碍、合并症、感染、呼吸支持、用药，以及基于 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 的滚动窗口。

sents.en: The benchmark does not measure bedside reasoning, diagnosis, treatment planning, real-time prediction, or downstream study validity.
sents.zh: 该基准不衡量床旁推理、诊断、治疗规划、实时预测或下游研究的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Relative to EHR text-to-SQL, structured-QA, and interactive-agent benchmarks ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , M4Bench evaluates the reproduction of declared clinical derivations instead of answers to EHR questions. It turns procedural knowledge such as item identifiers, time windows, and tie-breaking rules into clinician-reviewed, versioned artifacts. These artifacts help some derivations and leave others flat or negative when grain, timing, or reconstruction fail.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于EHR文本到SQL、结构化问答以及交互式智能体基准（Lee et al., 2022；Yang et al., 2026；Jiang et al., 2025），M4Bench评估的是对已声明临床衍生过程的复现，而非对EHR问题的回答。 它将诸如条目标识符、时间窗口和平局裁决规则等程序性知识转化为经临床医生审核的、带有版本管理的工件。 这些工件对某些衍生过程有所帮助，而当粒度、时机或重建失败时，对另一些则没有改善甚至产生负面影响。

Operational specifications without item identifiers already capture most of the gain, so the effect is not unique to the skill format. Skills barely change key F1 on average and improve output grain on only a few tasks. With 26 MIMIC-IV and two eICU tasks, the evidence is not dataset- or hospital-general. paragraphs.en: Given the residual failures, agent builders should pair procedural guidance with executable checks. Before coding, declare the output grain, keys, window boundaries, units, missingness and tie-breaking rules, and source mappings. Before accepting output, validate columns, key coverage, duplicate and extra keys, cohort size, value ranges, intermediate counts, and boundary cases, because skills barely move key F1 or strict pass. Agents also need reliable primitives for temporal joins, unit normalization, and item-code mapping, and should expose intermediate cohorts and values for inspection. Contestable choices should be surfaced, not silently resolved, and practitioners should treat agent output as an untrusted draft that needs independent clinical review before consequential use. Expert-curated examples help most when they carry the definition, dataset mappings, expected intermediate and final outputs, edge cases, tests, provenance, and known limitations, not only final SQL.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于仍然存在的失败情况，智能体构建者应将程序性指导与可执行的检查相结合。 在编写代码之前，应声明输出的粒度、键、窗口边界、单位、缺失值处理与并列打破规则，以及来源映射。 在接受输出之前，应校验各列、键覆盖率、重复键与多余键、队列规模、取值范围、中间计数以及边界情况，因为技能对关键 F1 或严格通过率的提升微乎其微。 智能体还需要可靠的基础原语来处理时间连接、单位归一化和项目代码映射，并应暴露中间队列与数值以供检查。 有争议的选择应当被显式呈现，而不是被默默解决，实践者应将智能体的输出视为不可信的草稿，在产生重大影响的使用之前需要进行独立的临床审查。 专家精选的示例最有帮助的时候，是它们包含定义、数据集映射、预期的中间与最终输出、边界情况、测试、来源出处和已知局限，而不仅仅是最终的 SQL。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench evaluates derived variables for supervised research workflows, not autonomous clinical decision-making. Incorrect derivations propagate into cohorts, risk adjustment, and downstream conclusions, and high reward can coexist with consequential grain, timing, or missingness errors. References can embed contestable choices (Appendix Table 9 ), so human audit and provenance tracking remain necessary.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 评估的是监督型研究工作流中的衍生变量，而非自主的临床决策。 错误的衍生会传播到队列构建、风险调整和下游结论中，并且高奖励可能与严重的粒度、时机或缺失数据错误并存。 参考答案可能嵌入有争议的选择（附录表 9），因此人工审计和溯源追踪仍然必不可少。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench is an evaluation benchmark for procedural specification in clinical EHR derivation agents. Explicit procedural specifications, instantiated here as clinician-reviewed skills, improve agreement with declared reference outputs for Codex, with a directionally consistent descriptive Claude replication, while leaving important failures in temporal joins, output grain, and raw intermediate reconstruction. The result shows that schema exploration alone is often insufficient and gives readers an artifact-backed way to inspect residual errors requiring human audit.
paragraphs.zh: M4Bench 是一个面向临床电子健康档案（EHR）衍生智能体中程序性规范的评估基准。 以经临床医生审核的技能形式实例化的显式程序性规范，提升了 Codex 与声明性参考输出的一致性，并在 Claude 上得到了方向一致的描述性复现，但在时间连接、输出粒度和原始中间结果重建方面仍存在重要失败。 该结果表明，仅靠模式探索往往是不够的，并为读者提供了一种有产物支撑的方式来检查需要人工审计的残余错误。

paragraphs.en: M4Bench is designed to be extended through task.toml files with paired reference-output implementations, evaluation configuration, and clinician-reviewed skills. Researchers can add tasks, skills, controls, and agents under the same no-skill versus with-skill comparison, isolation harness, and evidence standards to measure the value of agent skills in other clinical EHR settings. Future versions should add mechanism controls on all 28 tasks, clinician-adjudicated targets, multiple accepted derivations, broader eICU and cross-site tasks, and care-process task families.

paragraphs.en: The 15 task families cover severity scores, neurological status, renal and liver dysfunction, comorbidity, infection, respiratory support, medications, and rolling-window data engineering. Ten families derive from published scores and definitions: SOFA [ Vincent et al., 1996 ] , APS III [ Knaus et al., 1991 ] , SAPS II [ Le Gall et al., 1993 ] , OASIS [ Johnson et al., 2013 ] , GCS [ Teasdale and Jennett, 1974 ] , the Charlson comorbidity index [ Charlson et al., 1987 ] , SIRS [ Bone et al., 1992 ] , MELD [ Kamath et al., 2001 ] , KDIGO AKI staging [ KDIGO Acute Kidney Injury Work Group, 2012 ] , and Sepsis-3 [ Singer et al., 2016 ] . The reference SQL adapts each definition to its database following the source basis in Table 7 . The full task inventory is generated from benchmark/tasks/*/*/task.toml .
paragraphs.zh: 这 15 个任务族涵盖严重程度评分、神经系统状态、肾功能障碍与肝功能障碍、合并症、感染、呼吸支持、用药情况以及滚动窗口数据工程。 其中十个任务族源自已发表的评分与定义：SOFA [ Vincent et al., 1996 ]、APS III [ Knaus et al., 1991 ]、SAPS II [ Le Gall et al., 1993 ]、OASIS [ Johnson et al., 2013 ]、GCS [ Teasdale and Jennett, 1974 ]、Charlson 合并症指数 [ Charlson et al., 1987 ]、SIRS [ Bone et al., 1992 ]、MELD [ Kamath et al., 2001 ]、KDIGO AKI 分期 [ KDIGO Acute Kidney Injury Work Group, 2012 ] 以及 Sepsis-3 [ Singer et al., 2016 ]。 参考依据表 7 中的来源基础，将每个定义适配到相应数据库，形成参考 SQL。 完整任务清单由 benchmark/tasks/*/*/task.toml 生成。

paragraphs.en: Each task specifies required identifier columns and value columns. paragraphs.en: In MIMIC-IV, antibiotics come from systemic prescriptions orders (topical, ophthalmic, and otic routes excluded) and cultures from microbiologyevents . A culture is positive when an organism is reported. Cultures with a collection date but no time use day-level windows (three days before, one day after). If both directions match, the culture-before-antibiotic match takes precedence, and within a direction the earliest eligible culture is chosen. The standard task keeps the curated antibiotic table, and the raw task removes it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MIMIC-IV 中，抗生素来自全身给药的处方医嘱（排除外用、眼部和耳部给药途径），培养标本来自 microbiologyevents 表。 当报告了病原体时，该培养即为阳性。 有采集日期但无采集时间的培养使用天级时间窗（前三天、后一天）。 若两个方向都匹配，则优先采用培养在抗生素之前的匹配，且在同一方向内选择最早的符合条件的培养。 标准任务保留经整理的抗生素表，而原始任务则将其移除。

paragraphs.en: On the standard task in the primary Codex comparison, key precision is 1.000 in both conditions and mean key F1 is at least 0.999, so both conditions get the grain right. Reward rises from 0.720 to 0.820, and the unscored diagnostic match on culture_time rises from 0.46 to 0.69: the skill mainly corrects which culture is paired to each antibiotic (precedence and earliest-culture rules). No run in either condition passes strictly (0/10 each). On the raw task, where the agent must also rebuild the antibiotic table, grain is a problem as well: mean key F1 is 0.725 without and 0.865 with the skill. A clinically plausible rule applied with the wrong window or tie-break therefore still produces incorrect rows, and the reference itself inherits the broad culture inclusion noted in Table 9 .

paragraphs.en: The decoy-skill and raw-SQL controls share one purposive 10-task list, committed to the benchmark matrix on 2 May 2026 (commit 3405cc45 ) before the first control run on 3 May. It spans 6/15 families, five standard and five raw tasks, and nine MIMIC-IV tasks plus one eICU task. The operational-spec control uses the same eight tasks as the sentinel list that has been in the benchmark matrix since 23 April 2026 ( 4245cc81 ), twelve days before the first operational-spec run on 6 May. The commits that added the operational-spec files and the condition itself ( fce2bd24 , 949836d9 ) were authored 62 and 70 minutes after that run started, so the pre-specification rests on the earlier list. The list spans 8/15 families, three standard and five raw tasks, and no eICU task. Commit times are author dates compared in UTC, and committer dates reflect a later history rewrite. The eight-task list was chosen from a single-seed Opus pilot with 27 valid tasks and holds five pilot high-delta tasks, one flat task, and two pilot-negative tasks (categories in benchmark/matrix.py ). With a budget of 100 runs per control, we placed the decoy-skill and raw-SQL controls on the ten tasks with the largest skill delta in the earlier April 2026 Codex campaign ( codex-full-20260428 ), where a difference between conditions was most likely to show. Under the Opus-pilot categories these are eight high-delta tasks, one flat task, and one negative task. Selection used the April runs, and the control results reported here come from separate May runs. Table 13 reports membership and the final targeted-skill delta per task. The subset deltas (+0.280 and +0.186) exceed their complements (+0.056 and +0.116), so control results describe these subsets rather than the full benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 诱饵技能与原始 SQL 控件共享同一份包含 10 个任务的目的性任务列表，于 2026 年 5 月 2 日（提交 3405cc45）提交至基准矩阵，早于 5 月 3 日的首次控件运行。 它覆盖 15 个族中的 6 个，包含五个标准任务和五个原始任务，以及九个 MIMIC-IV 任务和一个 eICU 任务。 操作规范控件使用与哨兵列表相同的八个任务，该列表自 2026 年 4 月 23 日（4245cc81）起就在基准矩阵中，比 5 月 6 日的首次操作规范运行早十二天。 添加操作规范文件及该条件本身的提交（fce2bd24、949836d9）是在那次运行开始后 62 分钟和 70 分钟才编写的，因此预先规范依据的是更早的那份列表。 该列表覆盖 15 个族中的 8 个，包含三个标准任务和五个原始任务，且不含 eICU 任务。 提交时间是指以 UTC 比较的作者日期，而提交者日期反映的是较晚的一次历史重写。 这份八任务列表选自一个仅有单一种子、包含 27 个有效任务的 Opus 试点，其中包含五个试点高差异任务、一个平缓任务和两个试点负面任务（类别见 benchmark/matrix.py）。 在每次控件 100 次运行的预算下，我们将诱饵技能与原始 SQL 控件放在 2026 年 4 月早些时候 Codex 战役（codex-full-20260428）中技能差异最大的十个任务上，在这些任务上条件之间的差异最有可能显现。 按 Opus 试点类别来看，这些任务是八个高差异任务、一个平缓任务和一个负面任务。 选择使用的是 4 月的运行结果，而这里报告的控件结果来自 5 月的独立运行。 表 13 报告了各任务的成员归属及最终的目标技能差异。 子集差异（+0.280 和 +0.186）超过了其补集差异（+0.056 和 +0.116），因此控件结果描述的是这些子集而非完整基准。

paragraphs.en: The final Codex evidence package combines release-20260502-codex-v11 with 170 clinician-review rerun replacements from review-rerun-20260504-codex . After treating legacy SQL-free variant runs as the canonical with-skill rows for the four affected task variants, the analysis set contains 760 runs across 152 task/condition/schema/model cells. Those four variants are the standard and raw urine-output-rate and vasopressor-equivalent tasks. Their SQL-free skill text marked each stripped SQL fragment with a placeholder. On 5 May 2026 (commit 5f3ac09c ) the placeholders were replaced by written rules, and that later text is the released skill and the one the Codex follow-up and the Claude replication used. For these four tasks the primary Codex and Claude with-skill runs therefore did not see the same skill text. Publishability establishes eligibility for analysis, not clinical correctness: most failed diagnostics are valid failed or partially correct derivations, which is why the scalar reward is interpreted alongside key precision, extra-key counts, and strict pass/fail status.
paragraphs.zh: 最终的 Codex 证据包将 release-20260502-codex-v11 与来自 review-rerun-20260504-codex 的 170 个临床医生复核重跑替换项合并在一起。 在将旧的无 SQL 变体运行视为四个受影响任务变体的规范的有技能行之后，分析集包含 152 个任务/条件/模式/模型单元格中的 760 次运行。 这四个变体是标准版和原始版的尿输出率与血管加压药等效任务。 它们的无 SQL 技能文本用占位符标记了每个被剥离的 SQL 片段。 在 2026 年 5 月 5 日（commit 5f3ac09c），这些占位符被书面规则取代，而后来的文本即是已发布的技能，也是 Codex 后续实验与 Claude 复现所使用的文本。 因此，对于这四个任务，主要的 Codex 与 Claude 有技能运行并未看到相同的技能文本。 可发布性确立的是进入分析的资格，而非临床正确性：大多数失败的诊断是有效的失败或部分正确的推导，这也是为什么标量奖励需要与关键精确度、多余键数量以及严格的通过/失败状态一起解读。

paragraphs.en: The May 6 Codex validity follow-up contains 363 raw result directories. The canonical analysis manifest selects the latest timestamped run for each task, condition, schema, model, and trial key, yielding 340 canonical runs and 23 superseded retry directories. The canonical matrix contains 80 operational-spec runs and 260 transformed-schema with-skill runs. All canonical runs pass publishability, isolation, filesystem-canary, and contamination-lint checks. paragraphs.en: The canonical 560 runs combine 11 tasks completed in a local root ( rebuttal-claude-opus-sonnet-20260726 , 220 runs), seven disjoint tasks from a second local root ( rebuttal-claude-opus-sonnet-additional-20260728 , 140 runs), and ten tasks completed by a collaborator ( claude-28-20260726 , 200 runs, newest attempt per cell). As a descriptive cross-cohort check, 11 collaborator cells were also completed locally with five runs each (within the 57 overlapping runs): the mean absolute difference between their cell means and the canonical ones is 0.021, the largest 0.052, and substituting the local runs for the two fully duplicated tasks moves the 28-task delta from +0.1196 to +0.1205 (computed from the released canonical manifest and attempt inventory). paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要观点是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction frame M4Bench as an evaluation benchmark for reference EHR derivation agreement, not as validation of autonomous clinical correctness. The main claims are bounded to curated procedural context under the declared benchmark conditions, and the cross-provider Claude replication is presented as descriptive because its harness was not uniform.
paragraphs.zh: 评审理由：摘要与引言将 M4Bench 定位为用于评估参考电子健康记录（EHR）生成一致性的评测基准，而非对自主临床正确性的验证。 主要论断限定在所声明的基准条件下经过筛选的程序性情境之内，且由于跨提供商的 Claude 复现实验所用测试框架并不统一，因此仅作描述性呈现。

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 6 discusses what the benchmark measures, interpretation limits and non-claims, statistical and external validity, and safety boundaries; Sections 1 and 3 state the scope of clinician review and of the no-skill baseline.

paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示论文没有局限性，而回答 [No] 表示论文存在局限性，但论文中未对其进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未承认的局限性。 作者应尽其最佳判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在发展维护社区诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 审稿人将被特别指示不要因对局限性的坦诚而进行惩罚。

sents.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper.
sents.zh: 虽然作者可能担心对局限性完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中未承认的局限性。

sents.en: The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community.
sents.zh: 作者应尽其最佳判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在发展维护社区诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。

sents.en: Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
sents.zh: 审稿人将被特别指示不要因对局限性的坦诚而进行惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每项理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper introduces an evaluation benchmark and empirical protocol; it does not present theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该论文提出了一个评估基准和实证协议，并未给出理论结果。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含理论结果。

paragraphs.en: All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中所有定理、公式和证明都应编号并交叉引用。

paragraphs.en: All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
paragraphs.zh: 所有假设均应在任何定理的陈述中被清晰地说明或引用。

paragraphs.en: The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 证明可以出现在正文或补充材料中，但如果出现在补充材料中，鼓励作者提供一个简短的证明思路以帮助理解。

paragraphs.en: Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 反之，论文正文中提供的任何非正式证明，都应由附录或补充材料中提供的正式证明加以补充。

paragraphs.en: Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 证明所依赖的定理和引理应当被恰当地引用。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否充分披露了复现论文主要实验结果所需的全部信息，以至于影响到论文的主要论断和/或结论（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Sections 3–4 and the appendix specify tasks, conditions, metrics, execution, isolation, result roots, artifact retention, and repeated-trial aggregation. Exact replay of individual agent trajectories may differ because coding agents and hosted model APIs are nondeterministic, so the paper reports task-balanced effects with bootstrap intervals and sign-flip tests, and releases per-run metadata, sanitized per-run evidence packages with hash lineage, canonical run manifests, and scripts that regenerate the result tables from those packages, except the schema-generalization table, whose no-skill cells come from runs outside the packages (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 理由说明：第 3–4 节与附录规定了任务、条件、指标、执行方式、隔离机制、结果根目录、工件保留以及重复试验的聚合方法。 由于编码智能体与托管模型 API 具有非确定性，单个智能体轨迹的精确重放可能有所不同，因此本文报告了带自助法区间和符号翻转检验的任务平衡效应，并发布了每次运行的元数据、带有哈希谱系的经脱敏的每次运行证据包、规范的运行清单，以及可从这些证据包重新生成结果表格的脚本，但模式泛化表除外，其无技能单元格的数据来自证据包之外的运行（附录 D）。

sents.en: Justification: Sections 3–4 and the appendix specify tasks, conditions, metrics, execution, isolation, result roots, artifact retention, and repeated-trial aggregation.
sents.zh: 理由说明：第 3–4 节与附录规定了任务、条件、指标、执行方式、隔离机制、结果根目录、工件保留以及重复试验的聚合方法。

sents.en: Exact replay of individual agent trajectories may differ because coding agents and hosted model APIs are nondeterministic, so the paper reports task-balanced effects with bootstrap intervals and sign-flip tests, and releases per-run metadata, sanitized per-run evidence packages with hash lineage, canonical run manifests, and scripts that regenerate the result tables from those packages, except the schema-generalization table, whose no-skill cells come from runs outside the packages (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 由于编码智能体与托管模型 API 具有非确定性，单个智能体轨迹的精确重放可能有所不同，因此本文报告了带自助法区间和符号翻转检验的任务平衡效应，并发布了每次运行的元数据、带有哈希谱系的经脱敏的每次运行证据包、规范的运行清单，以及可从这些证据包重新生成结果表格的脚本，但模式泛化表除外，其无技能单元格的数据来自证据包之外的运行（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含实验。

paragraphs.en: If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果论文包含实验，审稿人对该问题的 [No] 回答会产生不好的印象：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文具有可复现性都是重要的。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述其为使结果可复现或可验证所采取的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可复现性可以通过多种方式来实现。 例如，如果贡献是一种新的架构，那么完整地描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体的模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。 一般来说，发布代码和数据往往是实现这一点的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供如何复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点，或采取适合所做研究的其他方式来保障。

sents.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways.
sents.zh: 根据贡献的不同，可复现性可以通过多种方式来实现。

sents.en: For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model.
sents.zh: 例如，如果贡献是一种新的架构，那么完整地描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体的模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。

sents.en: In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
sents.zh: 一般来说，发布代码和数据往往是实现这一点的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供如何复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点，或采取适合所做研究的其他方式来保障。

paragraphs.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有投稿提供某种合理的可复现性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新算法，论文应清楚说明如何复现该算法。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新的模型架构，论文应清晰、完整地描述该架构。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是一个新模型（例如，一个大语言模型），那么应当提供一种访问该模型以复现结果的方式，或提供一种复现该模型的方式（例如，使用开源数据集或提供如何构建该数据集的说明）。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较困难，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为提供可复现性而采取的具体方式。 就闭源模型而言，对模型的访问可能受到某种限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

sents.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较困难，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为提供可复现性而采取的具体方式。

sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 就闭源模型而言，对模型的访问可能受到某种限制（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否如补充材料中所述，提供了数据和代码的开放访问，并附带足够 instructions，能够忠实地复现主要实验结果？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The tagged source release contains evaluation code, task specifications, skills, the isolation harness, credentialed reconstruction instructions, run manifests, and table scripts; open evidence packages with checksums and Croissant metadata contain per-run results and sanitized traces (Appendix D ). MIMIC-IV and eICU, derived task databases, reference outputs, and row-level agent outputs remain subject to PhysioNet credentialing and data-use terms, so data-layer reproduction requires independent credentialed access.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：打了标签的源代码发布版本包含评估代码、任务规范、技能、隔离环境、凭据重建说明、运行清单和表格脚本；附带校验和与 Croissant 元数据的开放证据包包含每次运行的结果和经过脱敏的轨迹（附录 D）。 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU、衍生的任务数据库、参考输出以及行级智能体输出仍受 PhysioNet 凭据认证和数据使用条款约束，因此数据层的复现需要独立获得凭据访问权限。

sents.en: Justification: The tagged source release contains evaluation code, task specifications, skills, the isolation harness, credentialed reconstruction instructions, run manifests, and table scripts; open evidence packages with checksums and Croissant metadata contain per-run results and sanitized traces (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 理由：打了标签的源代码发布版本包含评估代码、任务规范、技能、隔离环境、凭据重建说明、运行清单和表格脚本；附带校验和与 Croissant 元数据的开放证据包包含每次运行的结果和经过脱敏的轨迹（附录 D）。

sents.en: MIMIC-IV and eICU, derived task databases, reference outputs, and row-level agent outputs remain subject to PhysioNet credentialing and data-use terms, so data-layer reproduction requires independent credentialed access.
sents.zh: MIMIC-IV 和 eICU、衍生的任务数据库、参考输出以及行级智能体输出仍受 PhysioNet 凭据认证和数据使用条款约束，因此数据层的复现需要独立获得凭据访问权限。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 该答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）以了解更多详情。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这也许无法做到，因此 [No]（否）是可以接受的答案。 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒稿，除非代码是该贡献的核心部分（例如，对于一个新的开源基准测试而言）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这也许无法做到，因此 [No]（否）是可以接受的答案。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 论文不能仅仅因为没有包含代码而被拒稿，除非代码是该贡献的核心部分（例如，对于一个新的开源基准测试而言）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供关于数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成的数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。 如果只有部分实验可复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果只有部分实验可复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 在提交时，为保持匿名性，作者应发布匿名版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附于论文之后）中提供尽可能多的信息，但允许包含数据和代码的 URL。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否说明了理解结果所需的全部训练与测试细节（例如：数据划分、超参数、这些超参数是如何选择的、优化器的类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The study does not train models. Sections 3–4 describe benchmark construction, model/provider arms, conditions, trials, scoring, isolation, and recorded reporting fields.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本研究不训练模型。 第3–4节描述基准构建、模型/提供方分支、条件、试验、评分、隔离，以及记录的报告字段。

sents.en: Justification: The study does not train models.
sents.zh: 理由：本研究不训练模型。

sents.en: Sections 3–4 describe benchmark construction, model/provider arms, conditions, trials, scoring, isolation, and recorded reporting fields.
sents.zh: 第3–4节描述基准构建、模型/提供方分支、条件、试验、评分、隔离，以及记录的报告字段。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文的核心部分呈现，其详细程度应足以使读者理解这些结果并领会其意义。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整细节可通过随代码提供、放在附录中或作为补充材料的方式给出。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否恰当地报告了误差条及其正确定义，或其他关于实验统计显著性的适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 4 defines the uncertainty procedure using task-cluster bootstrap intervals, family-cluster sensitivity analysis, and a Monte Carlo sign-flip test against zero. Section 5 and the appendix report bootstrap intervals for the relevant task-balanced effect estimates, and Section 4 states that bracketed intervals are 95% non-parametric percentile bootstrap intervals over task-level deltas, not standard deviations or standard errors over repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 依据：第 4 节使用任务簇自助区间、族簇敏感性分析以及针对零的蒙特卡洛符号翻转检验来定义不确定性程序。 第 5 节及附录报告了相关任务均衡效应估计的自助区间，并且第 4 节说明方括号内的区间是基于任务级增量的 95% 非参数百分位自助区间，而非重复运行的标准差或标准误。

sents.en: Justification: Section 4 defines the uncertainty procedure using task-cluster bootstrap intervals, family-cluster sensitivity analysis, and a Monte Carlo sign-flip test against zero.
sents.zh: 依据：第 4 节使用任务簇自助区间、族簇敏感性分析以及针对零的蒙特卡洛符号翻转检验来定义不确定性程序。

sents.en: Section 5 and the appendix report bootstrap intervals for the relevant task-balanced effect estimates, and Section 4 states that bracketed intervals are 95% non-parametric percentile bootstrap intervals over task-level deltas, not standard deviations or standard errors over repeated runs.
sents.zh: 第 5 节及附录报告了相关任务均衡效应估计的自助区间，并且第 4 节说明方括号内的区间是基于任务级增量的 95% 非参数百分位自助区间，而非重复运行的标准差或标准误。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果结果附有误差条、置信区间或统计显著性检验，作者应回答 [Yes]，至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验应如此。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒所捕捉到的变异因素应清楚说明（例如，训练/测试集划分、初始化、某个参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒的计算方法应加以说明（闭式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 应给出所做的假设（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应明确误差棒是标准差还是平均值的标准误差。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 报告 1-sigma 误差棒是可以的，但应当予以说明。 如果误差服从正态分布的假设未得到验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差棒，而不是声称他们有 96% 的置信区间。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 报告 1-sigma 误差棒是可以的，但应当予以说明。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果误差服从正态分布的假设未得到验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差棒，而不是声称他们有 96% 的置信区间。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于非对称分布，作者应注意不要在表格或图中展示会产生超出范围结果（例如，负的错误率）的对称误差棒。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果误差线在表格或图中有所报告，作者应在正文中解释其计算方式，并在正文中引用相应的图或表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息说明复现实验所需的计算机资源（计算工作器的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Appendix Table 11 reports hardware, retained-run wall-clock time, token usage, and retained artifact storage for the Codex primary and Claude sentinel campaigns. For the full-coverage Claude replication we report summed agent wall-clock time by condition (Appendix Table 30 ); hardware was not recorded per run. Compute for the Codex follow-up, the exploratory OSS arm, pilot runs, and excluded attempts is not reported.
paragraphs.zh: 依据：附录表 11 报告了 Codex 主实验与 Claude 哨兵活动的硬件、保留运行的墙上时钟时间、token 用量及保留产物的存储情况。 对于全覆盖的 Claude 复制实验，我们按条件报告智能体墙上时钟时间之和（附录表 30）；硬件未按每次运行单独记录。 Codex 后续实验、探索性 OSS 分支、试运行及被排除的尝试所用的计算资源未予报告。

sents.en: Justification: Appendix Table 11 reports hardware, retained-run wall-clock time, token usage, and retained artifact storage for the Codex primary and Claude sentinel campaigns.
sents.zh: 依据：附录表 11 报告了 Codex 主实验与 Claude 哨兵活动的硬件、保留运行的墙上时钟时间、token 用量及保留产物的存储情况。

sents.en: For the full-coverage Claude replication we report summed agent wall-clock time by condition (Appendix Table 30 ); hardware was not recorded per run.
sents.zh: 对于全覆盖的 Claude 复制实验，我们按条件报告智能体墙上时钟时间之和（附录表 30）；硬件未按每次运行单独记录。

sents.en: Compute for the Codex follow-up, the exploratory OSS arm, pilot runs, and excluded attempts is not reported.
sents.zh: Codex 后续实验、探索性 OSS 分支、试运行及被排除的尝试所用的计算资源未予报告。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明计算工作者的类型（CPU 或 GPU）、内部集群或云服务提供商，包括相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应提供每个单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应披露完整的研究项目是否需要比论文中报告的实验更多的计算资源（例如，未能写入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中所开展的研究在各方面是否符合 NeurIPS 伦理准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The benchmark uses credentialed de-identified clinical research databases under their data-use agreements, follows source-data access restrictions for derived databases and potentially data-bearing artifacts, and limits claims to supervised research derivations rather than clinical deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该基准测试在其数据使用协议下使用经授权的去标识化临床研究数据库，遵循派生数据库及潜在承载数据的工件的数据访问限制，并将主张限定于有监督的研究派生，而非临床部署。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 伦理准则。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [否]，则应说明需要偏离《伦理准则》的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，如果因其所在司法管辖区的法律或法规而有特殊考虑）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否既讨论了所做工作潜在的正向社会影响，也讨论了潜在的负向社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Section 1 states the intended benefit, making clinical derivation knowledge versioned and auditable for supervised research workflows, and Section 6 discusses risks from incorrect derivations propagating into cohorts, risk adjustment, or downstream analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：第 1 节阐述了预期收益，即将临床推导知识进行版本化管理并可审计，以支持有监督的研究工作流；第 6 节讨论了不正确推导传播至队列、风险调整或下游分析所带来的风险。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示所完成的工作没有社会影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [No]，他们应当解释为什么其工作没有社会影响，或者为什么该论文未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面社会影响的例子包括潜在的恶意或非预期用途（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假档案、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能做出对特定群体产生不公平影响决策的技术）、隐私考量和安全考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 会议预计许多论文将属于基础研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用来生成用于虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。 另一方面，无需指出用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出生成深度伪造的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 会议预计许多论文将属于基础研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成式模型质量的提升可能被用来生成用于虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，无需指出用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出生成深度伪造的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应考虑以下可能产生的危害：技术在被按预期使用且正常运行时可能产生的危害；技术在被按预期使用但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害；以及因（有意或无意的）滥用技术而导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面的社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的受控发布、在提供攻击之外同时提供防御手段、监控滥用行为的机制、监控系统如何随时间从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习（ML）的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布具有较高滥用风险的数据或模型（例如，预训练语言模型、图像生成器或抓取的数据集）而采取的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The release respects PhysioNet credentialing for MIMIC-IV and eICU data, releases only sanitized per-run evidence that withholds row-level outputs and tool outputs and is scanned for residual identifiers and shifted dates, keeps the original data-bearing archives private, and does not claim clinical deployment readiness.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该发布遵守了 PhysioNet 对 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU 数据的资质认证要求，仅发布经过清理的单次运行证据，其中不包含行级输出和工具输出，并经过残留标识符和日期偏移的扫描检查；同时保持原始含数据的档案私有，且不声称具备临床部署就绪性。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 存在高风险误用或双重用途风险的已发布模型，应当附带必要的安全保障措施以便对模型进行受控使用，例如要求用户遵守使用指南或访问限制，或实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应说明他们如何避免发布不安全的图像。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的保障措施具有挑战性，许多论文也不要求这一点，但我们鼓励作者将此纳入考虑，并尽最大努力去做。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原始所有者是否得到了恰当的署名，且许可证和使用条款是否被明确说明并得到恰当遵守？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper cites MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code and names the evaluated agent products and model identifiers in Section 4. Section 3 and the appendix asset-license table report dataset versions, source-asset roles, PhysioNet credentialing/data-use terms and URLs, the M4Bench MIT release license, and access restrictions for derived databases and data-bearing artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 理由说明：论文引用了 MIMIC-IV、eICU 和 MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code，并在第 4 节中列出了所评估的智能体产品名称及模型标识符。 第 3 节和附录中的资产许可表报告了数据集版本、源资产的角色、PhysioNet 的资质认证与数据使用条款及相应网址、M4Bench 的 MIT 发布许可证，以及派生数据库和含数据产物的访问限制。

sents.en: Justification: The paper cites MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code and names the evaluated agent products and model identifiers in Section 4.
sents.zh: 理由说明：论文引用了 MIMIC-IV、eICU 和 MIT-LCP MIMIC-Code，并在第 4 节中列出了所评估的智能体产品名称及模型标识符。

sents.en: Section 3 and the appendix asset-license table report dataset versions, source-asset roles, PhysioNet credentialing/data-use terms and URLs, the M4Bench MIT release license, and access restrictions for derived databases and data-bearing artifacts.
sents.zh: 第 3 节和附录中的资产许可表报告了数据集版本、源资产的角色、PhysioNet 的资质认证与数据使用条款及相应网址、M4Bench 的 MIT 发布许可证，以及派生数据库和含数据产物的访问限制。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当引用产生该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明使用的是资产的哪个版本，并尽可能提供一个 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应包含许可证名称（例如 CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（例如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和服务条款。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布了资产，则应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于流行的数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。 其许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布了资产，则应提供软件包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于流行的数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 已为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 其许可指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证和派生资产的许可证（如果其发生了变化）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果该信息无法在线获取，我们鼓励作者联系该资产的创作者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，并且文档是否随资产一同提供？

paragraphs.en: Justification: M4Bench introduces task specifications, skills, evaluator code, and result artifacts. Sections 3–4 and the appendix document task inventory, clinician-review provenance, artifact retention, rerun requirements, and the evidence packages with checksums, licenses, and Croissant metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：M4Bench 引入了任务规范、技能、评估器代码和结果产物。 第 3–4 节及附录记录了任务清单、临床医生审核来源、产物保留情况、重运行要求，以及带有校验和、许可证和 Croissant 元数据的证据包。

sents.en: Justification: M4Bench introduces task specifications, skills, evaluator code, and result artifacts.
sents.zh: 说明：M4Bench 引入了任务规范、技能、评估器代码和结果产物。

sents.en: Sections 3–4 and the appendix document task inventory, clinician-review provenance, artifact retention, rerun requirements, and the evidence packages with checksums, licenses, and Croissant metadata.
sents.zh: 第 3–4 节及附录记录了任务清单、临床医生审核来源、产物保留情况、重运行要求，以及带有校验和、许可证和 Croissant 元数据的证据包。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未发布新资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员应在提交材料中通过结构化模板说明数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。 这包括有关训练、许可证、局限性等方面的细节。

sents.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates.
sents.zh: 研究人员应在提交材料中通过结构化模板说明数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。

sents.en: This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
sents.zh: 这包括有关训练、许可证、局限性等方面的细节。

paragraphs.en: The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应讨论是否以及如何从其资产被使用的人员那里获得同意。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，请记得对你的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

sents.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable).
sents.zh: 提交时，请记得对你的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。

sents.en: You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
sents.zh: 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与人类受试者研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于众包实验及涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否提供了给参与者的完整指令文本及截图（如适用），以及报酬细节（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not report crowdsourcing experiments or prospective human-subjects experiments. Clinician task review is provenance and face-validity review of benchmark artifacts, not an experimental subject intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文未报告众包实验或前瞻性人类受试者实验。 临床医生任务审查是对基准产物的来源与表面效度审查，而非对实验受试者的干预。

sents.en: Justification: The paper does not report crowdsourcing experiments or prospective human-subjects experiments.
sents.zh: 理由：本文未报告众包实验或前瞻性人类受试者实验。

sents.en: Clinician task review is provenance and face-validity review of benchmark artifacts, not an experimental subject intervention.
sents.zh: 临床医生任务审查是对基准产物的来源与表面效度审查，而非对实验受试者的干预。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不涉及众包，也不涉及以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 在补充材料中包含这些信息是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在正文中尽可能详细地包含相关细节。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 伦理准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作人员，其薪酬应至少达到数据收集者所在国家的最低工资标准。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 涉及人类受试者研究的机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等许可

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了研究参与者可能承担的风险、此类风险是否已向受试者披露，以及是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或基于您所在国家或机构要求的同等批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work uses de-identified credentialed clinical research databases and benchmark artifact review; it does not recruit study participants or run interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该工作使用去标识化的凭证化临床研究数据库和基准产物审查；不招募研究参与者，也不实施干预。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 根据开展研究的国家/地区不同，任何涉及人类受试者的研究可能都需要获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。 如果你获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准，应在论文中明确说明这一点。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关程序可能因机构和地点的不同而有显著差异，我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 伦理准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初次投稿，请勿包含任何可能破坏匿名性的信息（如适用），例如进行评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型（LLMs）是本研究核心方法中重要的、原创的或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用情况？ 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。
